messages:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: SEV2 alert - potential cross-tenant routing anomaly detected. 30s spike where requests from customer DeltaHealth (VPC vpc-42) are being routed to DedicatedPool-12 which is assigned to another tenant. Auto-triage score: high. Please ack and investigate.

maria (sre): acked. I'm oncall. pulling logs now. @kevin can you grab the route table snapshots and the LB mapping for DedicatedPool-12? Also need recent topology push from the mesh controller.

kevin (eng-runtime): on it. grabbing mapping and recent deploys. seeing a config push 09:12 UTC from infra-cicd that touched routing policy "route-selector-legacy". attaching excerpt:

```
2026-02-26T09:12:03Z INF policy-update id=route-selector-legacy author=infra-cicd
applied_rules:
  - match: tenant_tag == "delta-health" && vpc == "vpc-42"
    action: route_to: DedicatedPool-12
```

kevin (eng-runtime): hmm that looks wrong — delta-health should route to ReservedPool-7, not DedicatedPool-12. I'll fetch the controller audit.

jess (security): tagging for potential exposure. What's the customer impact window? any data plane copies observed?

maria (sre): initial request samples show 47 requests in the window 09:12:20 - 09:14:10. Payloads appear well-formed customer inference requests (short chat completions). No obvious PII tags in samples but can't be sure. We should assume possible exposure until proven otherwise.

anthony (solutions): looping in DeltaHealth CSM (external) via email after we have an initial customer-facing statement. Will hold until we confirm scope.

maria (sre): mitigation plan: 1) pause route-selector-legacy policy 2) move DeltaHealth routing back to ReservedPool-7 3) rotate ingress tokens for DedicatedPool-12 to block accidental replay. I'll do step 1-2 quickly.

kevin (eng-runtime): to pause policy run:

```
# controller cli
controllerctl policy disable route-selector-legacy --author=maria
controllerctl route set tenant=delta-health vpc=vpc-42 pool=ReservedPool-7
```

maria (sre): ran both. controllerctl returned success, new routing snapshot:

```
routes:
  delta-health vpc-42 -> ReservedPool-7 (effective 09:18:02 UTC)
```

ops-bot: system message: config-change applied by maria (sre) at 09:18:02 UTC. rolling restart to apply to edge routers started.

kevin (eng-runtime): confirming traffic cutover in metrics — tail latencies for DeltaHealth drop to baseline and no further hits to DedicatedPool-12 after 09:18:30. Good.

jess (security): good containment. still need to know whether any tokens/keys were logged or forwarded. maria can you export request headers for the 47 samples and look for auth headers / customer identifiers?

maria (sre): exporting. headers show x-customer-id and x-request-id, no raw auth header — our gateway strips Authorization before sending to pools. however some debug logs from DedicatedPool-12 contained the x-customer-id in message body due to a legacy debug dump.

maria (sre): found 3 debug dumps that contained request bodies in /var/log/debug/dump-*.log on DedicatedPool-12 host gpu-3a. Files copied to secure bucket for sec team's review.

jess (security): downloading. looking for PII or PHI patterns. If any PHI, we need legal + SOC. Running quick grep for SSN/medical keywords.

jess (security): quick scan: no SSN patterns. There are health terms but no identifiable patient names in these samples. Recommend full review but preliminary low likelihood of sensitive identifiers. We'll escalate if we find anything.

anthony (solutions): from product perspective, DeltaHealth will want a short incident summary and what we did. We should prepare: timeline, impact (47 requests), mitigation steps, and confirmation about no sensitive data exposed (pending sec deep-dive). I'll draft initial note.

maria (sre): timeline so far:
- 09:12:03 controller policy update pushed (route-selector-legacy)
- 09:12:20 anomalous routing observed (requests to DedicatedPool-12)
- 09:13:00 page triggered
- 09:18:02 policy disabled & routes corrected
- 09:18:30 traffic normalized

kevin (eng-runtime): root cause candidate: infra-cicd job that intended to patch an unrelated policy ended up using an outdated template with legacy selector due to a variable interpolation bug. I'll open a PR to fix templating and add an integration test.

jess (security): next steps for sec: full content review of the 47 payloads, retention assessment, and check if any logs from DedicatedPool-12 were forwarded to external log sinks (e.g., splunk indexes). I'll run queries.

maria (sre): oncall handoff in 25 minutes to kevin (if they agree). leaving notes in the incident playbook. any objections? :wave:

kevin (eng-runtime): I'll take the handoff. I'll keep the runbook running: audit controller, revoke any CICD token that did the push, and ensure DedicatedPool-12 debug dumps are quarantined.

ops-bot: reminder: please ack oncall handoff in 30m or escalate to rotations lead.

jess (security): sec update in 15: found one log forward to splunk index `edge-debug`, range covers 09:10-09:20. I've submitted deletion request for the three files and flagged retention to 0 for index entries from that time. Will confirm deletion with SOC.

anthony (solutions): drafted customer message (short):

"At 09:12 UTC we detected a routing misconfiguration that caused a small number of requests from your VPC to be routed to an incorrect execution pool. We immediately reverted the routing and mitigations were applied. We are conducting a full review; preliminary checks show no sensitive identifiers in the affected requests. We will follow up with the full investigation and any recommended remediations."

maria (sre): ok send that once jess confirms no PHI. otherwise add "we are investigating potential exposure to logs and will confirm." Keep legal on standby.

jess (security): sec confirms: no PHI found in the 47 payloads. splunk deletion requested. SOC will verify deletion and provide evidence.

maria (sre): updating incident channel: contained and mitigated. creating postmortem skeleton and assigning to kevin for root cause and infra-cicd fixes. assigning jess for log-retention & detection improvements.

kevin (eng-runtime): notes for postmortem: add required changes:
- fix infra-cicd template interpolation bug
- add CI test that verifies policy templating against a golden set
- disallow direct policy patches to "route-selector-legacy" without manual review
- add guardrails on debug dumps on Dedicated pools (auto-redact/policy)

maria (sre): handing off to kevin. I'm going offline for 30m but reachable if pagerduty escalates. please update this thread with customer comms and SOC deletion evidence.

kevin (eng-runtime): ack. taking it from here. will post next update after root cause PR and evidence from SOC. :thumbsup:

pagerduty-bot: incident marked as "mitigated" by maria (sre) at 09:30 UTC. follow-up tasks created: #INC-4982 (postmortem), #SEC-3121 (log-deletion verification), #ENG-7719 (ci-tests + templating fix).

maria (sre): closing the pager for now. great teamwork. :heart:
